def shapes(g):
    from collections import defaultdict
    d=defaultdict(set)
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v not in (0,5): d[v].add((i,j))
    return d
def norm(c):
    mi=min(i for i,j in c); mj=min(j for i,j in c)
    return frozenset((i-mi,j-mj) for i,j in c)
def hsym(n):
    h=max(i for i,j in n)
    return n==frozenset((h-i,j) for i,j in n)
def vsym(n):
    w=max(j for i,j in n)
    return n==frozenset((i,w-j) for i,j in n)

def transform(g):
    top={k:v for k,v in shapes(g).items() if max(i for i,j in v)<5}
    bot={k:v for k,v in shapes(g).items() if min(i for i,j in v)>5}
    H=g.index([r for r in g if 5 in r][0])  # separator row
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g)-H-1)]
    # bottom shapes: draw shifted up by H+1
    for c in bot.values():
        for i,j in c: out[i-H-1][j]=next(k for k,v in bot.items() if v==c)
    # symmetric top shapes not matching a bottom shape, stacked above
    inc=[]
    for k,c in top.items():
        n=norm(c)
        if (hsym(n) or vsym(n)) and not any(norm(c)==norm(b) for b in bot.values()):
            inc.append((k,c))
    # stack order: by color descending? place from bottom up
    # find topmost occupied row of bottom content
    def toprow(out):
        for i,r in enumerate(out):
            if any(r): return i
        return len(out)
    for k,c in sorted(inc, key=lambda x:-x[0]):
        n=norm(c); h=max(i for i,j in n); w=max(j for i,j in n)
        tr=toprow(out)
        # center column alignment: bottom shapes center col
        allbot=set().union(*bot.values()) if bot else set()
        bc=(min(j for i,j in allbot)+max(j for i,j in allbot))//2 if allbot else 0
        j0=bc-w//2
        # place so bottom row of shape = tr-1
        for i,j in n:
            out[tr-1-h+i][j0+j]=k
    return out

def transform(g):
    H=next(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if 5 in r)
    h,w=len(g)-H-1,len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    top=defaultdict(set); bot=defaultdict(set)
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v in (0,5): continue
            (top if i<H else bot)[v].add((i,j))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for c in bot.values():
        for i,j in c: out[i-H-1][j]=next(k for k,v in bot.items() if v is c or v==c)
    allbot=set().union(*bot.values())
    bc=(min(j for i,j in allbot)+max(j for i,j in allbot))//2
    tr=min(i for i,r in enumerate(out) if any(r))
    for k in sorted(top, reverse=True):
        c=top[k]; mi=min(i for i,j in c); mj=min(j for i,j in c)
        n=frozenset((i-mi,j-mj) for i,j in c)
        hh=max(i for i,j in n)+1; ww=max(j for i,j in n)+1
        if tr-hh<0: continue
        j0=bc-(ww-1)//2 if False else bc-max(j for i,j in n)//2
        for i,j in n: out[tr-hh+i][j0+j]=k
        tr-=hh
    return out
